ns2:course.label: Applied Mathematics in CHBE
ns2:course.description: Development of mathematical models and a survey of modern mathematical methods currently used in the solution of chemical and biomolecular engineering problems; topics include the application of vectors and matrices, partial differential equations, numerical analysis, and methods of optimization in Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering. Prerequisite: Consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Chemical Engineering major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
